credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/edelweiss.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BRACED: a low rosette of narrow woolly grey-green leaves hugging a limestone block, the raised lead leaf guarding one tight woolly white button bud on a short felted stem. The bud dips, then swells and lifts while a wisp of wool drifts off. Rosette, rock and stem stay fixed. WHITE: edelweiss is covered in white woolly hairs; the bracts and bud are genuinely white felt (shaded grey-green inside), and the limestone's lit top plane is pale stone. Woolly grey-green mid; dull yellow-olive dark for the flower heads and shading. Felt is clustered short marks; no enclosed dark dots. Sport: creamy-yellow felt, a natural colour variation of plants grown in shade and at lower altitude (not a named cultivar); geometry stays identical.
